one_liner: Threads API is a free Meta Graph-style REST API with OAuth 2.0 user tokens; only app roles/testers work without Meta App Review, so serving arbitrary users needs per-permission App Review. Only third-party MCP servers exist.
auth_notes: Authorization-code flow via the Authorization Window; short-lived tokens exchanged for 60-day long-lived tokens, refreshable.
access_notes: Developer credentials are self-serve through a Meta app with the Threads use case; testers can use it without review. Users without a role require each permission to pass App Review.
blocker_notes: Each Threads permission must be approved via App Review before users without an app role can grant it. Without advanced access to threads_basic, only posts created by Threads testers are retrievable.
